positioning.text: Penn Medicine states its mission as advancing knowledge and improving health through patient care, research and the education of trainees, and its About page cites the nation's first hospital (chartered 1751) and first medical school (founded 1765) as part of the system.
positioning.quote: Penn Medicine is an $11.9 billion enterprise powered by nearly 49,000 talented faculty and staff.

facts.text: On May 7, 2025 Penn Medicine announced a new PennMedicine.org that combined four separate health system websites into one, with revised doctor search and online appointment scheduling.

strengths.text: Its heritage and research record are specific and ownable: the 2026 brand campaign and the treatment pages both lean on documented firsts rather than general quality claims.
It consolidated four system websites into one in 2025, which puts doctor search and online scheduling for its regions on a single site under a local-access headline.
Vendor accounts describe service-line marketing managed against patient-volume outcomes rather than media metrics alone.

gaps.text: The About page's facilities sentence, as opened on 2026-11-10, names six hospitals and not Doylestown, which joined as the seventh hospital in April 2025.
A social media directory page on pennmedicine.org still listed Google+ when opened on 2026-11-10, alongside a web standards page that lists the current platforms.
TikTok is not among the social platforms Penn Medicine's web standards list as supported, as opened on 2026-11-10.

opportunitiesForUpmc.text: On the pages reviewed, Penn Medicine's podcasts are aimed at clinicians; UPMC could evaluate a consumer-facing audio or video series as a point of difference, after checking Penn Medicine's current line-up.
Penn Medicine's brand campaign is built on being first historically; UPMC could position on a different axis, such as access or present-day outcomes, instead of contesting heritage.
Penn Medicine's home page now carries a local-access message as its network grows; UPMC could check how its own regional pages answer that message wherever the two systems' service areas meet.
